notes_for_editor: Thin record. The Forest Lookouts Three Lakes page is headed 'Baraga County' and has no entries. The only other lookout-specific evidence is a map database point (Mapcarta, from OpenStreetMap, tagged as a tower), which does not say whether a structure stands there or that it was a fire lookout. Two web searches and the local NHLR, FFLOS and Michigan caches turned up nothing more. The michiganfiretower.com directory is JavaScript-loaded and only partly readable, so a Three Lakes entry there could not be ruled out. The story runs under the 120-word floor because the evidence is this thin; the editor may prefer to hold it or keep it as a stub. Brief coordinates (46.548, -88.17) agree with the map point to within about 0.01 degrees.
